format_outputdate.description: Output date format: strftime(3) compatible format string

general_autogc.description: Whether to automatically run garbage collector on note files

daemon_enable.description: Whether to start background daemon after exiting interactive mode

keys_bindings.description: List of custom key bindings; each entry maps a key to an action; format is [ {"key": "F1", "action": "help"}, ... ]

hooks_list.description: List of hooks; each entry has a name (pre-load, post-load, pre-save, post-save) and a filesystem path to an executable script
